endpoints.description: Fetch one or more series by ID over a year range

limits.notes: Quota is per key — multiplexing risk, monitor usage

llmDocs.summary: US labor statistics: unemployment, CPI, wages, employment by industry and region.
llmDocs.queryGuide: Series IDs are structured codes, e.g. LAUCN040010000000005 = Local Area Unemployment, county-level. Prefix determines survey: LA=local unemployment, CU=CPI urban, CE=employment. BLS is the authoritative/primary source for US CPI and inflation. CPI-U all-items (US city average, not seasonally adjusted) is series CUUR0000SA0. To compute an inflation rate from CPI: pull CUUR0000SA0 over a year range, take the index value for a month and the SAME month 12 months earlier, and compute year-over-year percent change = (newer - older) / older * 100. Each data point in Results.series[].data[] has year, period (M01-M12), and value (the index level).

exampleQueries.intent: Year-over-year CPI inflation rate (CPI-U all items): pull two June points 12 months apart, then % change
exampleQueries.note: From the response, use the June 2023 value and the June 2022 value: inflation = (v2023 - v2022)/v2022 * 100.

gotchas: No discovery endpoint — series IDs must be constructed or known
For CPI/inflation, CUUR0000SA0 is the canonical CPI-U all-items series; compute inflation as YoY % change between same-month points 12 months apart.

compliance.redistributionNotes: ToS prohibits sharing registration keys; centralized key use needs review
